name: Mosque Seal
summary: A mosque is cut into a broad circular seal, with an open edge and a warm carved accent.
why: The round outer silhouette feels grounded and lasting. Its mosque appears as real negative space, with a clear dome, tall minaret, and doorway. An opening on the right releases the circle, while the short copper arc adds a crafted character.
risk: The circular stamp can also suggest a mosque organization or certification. The open edge is intentional and should remain wide in small-size use.
sub1: Islamic identity carved into the mark
reasonToChoose: You want a compact emblem with the character of a carved seal.

palette.name: MOSQUE SEAL / DEEP BLUE + PARCHMENT + COPPER
